root.name: Discourse on the Method
root.description: Treatise by René Descartes, published in Leiden in 1637, in which he sets out his method "of rightly conducting one's reason and seeking truth in the sciences".

children.name: Author and Publication
children.description: The Discourse on the Method was written by René Descartes and published in Leiden in 1637.

children.name: Purpose of the Treatise
children.description: The work presents Descartes' method defined as being "of rightly conducting one's reason and seeking truth in the sciences".
